shared_elements: standing figure in strict profile facing one direction
figure with arm raised/extended and hand holding an object
low-relief figures with densely patterned infill (scale-like fleece / feathered wings and hatched hair)
elaborately rendered beard-like or crest-like head detail
figures filling a single rectangular field/register
justification: Both show profile standing figures in shallow relief with the same convention of covering hair, fleece or wings with fine repeated pattern, and in both a figure raises one hand while the other holds an object. But A depicts a procession of men leading horned rams, whereas B depicts a single bird-headed winged being flanking a stylized plant beneath a band of writing, so the actual subjects and their relationships are quite different.
